#!/bin/bash
echo "=============================="
echo "加入剪贴板自动同步到 GitHub"
echo "=============================="

cd /home/user/cloud-screen
cp main.py main.py.bak2

python3 << 'PYEOF'
content = open('main.py').read()

# 加入 GitHub 剪贴板上传函数
old = 'def upload_clipboard():'

new = '''def upload_to_github(text):
    """直接写入 GitHub，极其稳定"""
    import json, base64
    api = 'https://api.github.com/repos/' + GITHUB_USER + '/' + GITHUB_REPO + '/contents/clipboard.json'
    for attempt in range(3):
        try:
            # 取 sha
            r = requests.get(api, headers=github_headers, timeout=8)
            sha = r.json().get('sha', '') if r.status_code == 200 else ''
            # 写入
            data = json.dumps({'text': text, 'html': '', 'time': time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')})
            content_b64 = base64.b64encode(data.encode('utf-8')).decode()
            body = {'message': 'clip', 'content': content_b64}
            if sha:
                body['sha'] = sha
            r2 = requests.put(api, headers=github_headers, json=body, timeout=10)
            if r2.status_code in [200, 201]:
                print('剪贴板→GitHub ✅ ' + text[:20])
                return True
        except Exception as e:
            print('GitHub上传错误(第' + str(attempt+1) + '次): ' + str(e))
            time.sleep(1)
    print('❌ GitHub上传失败')
    return False

def upload_clipboard():'''

if old in content and 'upload_to_github' not in content:
    content = content.replace(old, new)
    print('✅ upload_to_github 函数已加入')
else:
    print('⚠️ 已存在或找不到')

# 改进 check_clipboard 使用 GitHub 上传
old2 = '''def check_clipboard():
    global last_clipboard
    try:
        r = subprocess.run(['xclip', '-selection', 'clipboard', '-o'], capture_output=True, env=ENV, timeout=2)
        text = r.stdout.decode('utf-8', errors='replace').strip()
        if text and text != last_clipboard:
            last_clipboard = text
            upload_clipboard()
    except:
        pass'''

new2 = '''def check_clipboard():
    global last_clipboard
    try:
        r = subprocess.run(['xclip', '-selection', 'clipboard', '-o'], capture_output=True, env=ENV, timeout=2)
        text = r.stdout.decode('utf-8', errors='replace').strip()
        if text and text != last_clipboard:
            last_clipboard = text
            upload_to_github(text)
    except:
        pass'''

if old2 in content:
    content = content.replace(old2, new2)
    print('✅ check_clipboard 已更新为 GitHub 上传')
else:
    print('⚠️ check_clipboard 找不到，可能已修改过')

open('main.py', 'w').write(content)
print('✅ main.py 更新完成')
PYEOF

sudo systemctl restart cloud-screen
sleep 3
sudo systemctl status cloud-screen | grep -E "Active|running|failed"
echo ""
echo "=============================="
echo "完成！现在复制任何内容都会自动同步到 GitHub"
echo "=============================="
